children: may fall to $100.33 per barrel after failing to break resistance at $103.66.
The strong bounce during the previous trading session appears to run counter to the downtrend from $109.96. A retracement analysis shows strong resistance at $103.66, the 50% level.
The market not only failed to overcome this barrier but also broke the support at $102.17. The next support is at $100.33, a break below which may trigger a fall to $99.20.
